about: Recorded by site/scripts/record-mcp.py. Requests and answers as they crossed standard input and output of rift-mcp.

sessions.what: 1 GiB pg_dump-like SQL pair with inserts, deletes, edits and moved blocks

steps.note: The client asks which tools the server has.

tools.name: hunks_at
tools.description: The difference in or next to a 1-based line of A, as unified diff text cut at `max_lines`.

a.description: Path of file A, the old one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

b.description: Path of file B, the new one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

context.description: Equal lines to show around the change, default 3, at most 20.

max_lines.description: Most diff lines to return, default 100, at most 500.

mem.description:
Memory budget for the diff of this pair, like `--mem`: `64M`, `1G`.
Used only when the call builds the diff; a live diff keeps its own.
Default 64M, at most 256M.

status.description: `differs`, or `approx` when the local diff was cut short.

found.description: Whether a difference lies within `context` lines of the line.

lines_total.description: Diff lines the whole hunk has.

range.description: The range, with its context, when found.

text.description: Unified diff text of the range, when found.

truncated.description: `text` stops before the end of the hunk.

tools.name: keyed_changes
tools.description: A page of the keys that differ between two files of records, as `keyed_summary` compares them: kind, table (COPY) and key, lines, both records, and for a changed key the fields that differ with old and new value. At most `limit` changes. For the next page pass the returned `next` as `cursor`, with the same files, `key`, `mem` and `fields`: a cursor of another call is refused, and then start again without one. Every page reruns the whole comparison over both files and keeps nothing, so a page costs as much as `keyed_summary`. Needs a `mem` of at least about 260K to 400K, depending on the pair, because 128 KiB of it is held for the answer. `fields` limits the comparison to named fields.

a.description: Path of file A, the old one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

b.description: Path of file B, the new one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

cursor.description:
Where the page starts: absent for the first page, else the `next` of
the last answer. A cursor is good only for the same files, `key`,
`mem` and `fields` it was issued for; any other call is refused,
and the client starts again without a cursor. `limit` may differ.

fields.description:
Compare only these fields, as `--fields`: a changed key whose
listed fields are equal is not returned and not counted. Names are
header cells, member names or COPY columns; for `csv:N` keys, column
numbers. An empty list means all fields.

key.description:
Where the key is, as `--key`: `csv:NAME` (header name), `csv:N`
(column N, from 1), `json:PATH` (NDJSON field, dotted for nested)
or `copy:NAME` (column of a `pg_dump` COPY block).

limit.description:
Most changes to return, default 20, at most 100. An answer also
stops at 64 KiB.

mem.description:
Memory budget for the diff of this pair, like `--mem`: `64M`, `1G`.
Used only when the call builds the diff; a live diff keeps its own.
Default 64M, at most 256M.

a_line.description: The record's first line in A, 1-based; null for an added key.

a_record.description:
A's record without its line terminator, cut at 1024 bytes; null for
an added key.

b_line.description: The record's first line in B; null for a removed key.

b_record.description: B's record; null for a removed key.

fields.description:
For a changed key, the fields that differ, at most 32, in A's order.
Empty when the records differ only in layout. Null for an added or
removed key, and for a record that does not split into fields (an
NDJSON line that is not one JSON object).

key.description: The key as the file has it, quotes included, cut at 256 bytes.

table.description:
The `COPY` table as its header names it, unescaped; null outside
`pg_dump` files.

a.description: The value in A, cut at 256 bytes; null when A's record lacks it.

b.description: The value in B; null when B's record lacks it.

name.description:
Header cell, member name or COPY column; the column number, from
1, for `csv:N` keys.

truncated.description: A name or a value was cut.

changed.description: Keys in both with different record bytes.

changes.description: The changes, in the order of the comparison.

mem_budget_bytes.description: Memory budget of the run, in bytes.

next.description: The `cursor` of the next page; null after the last change.

total.description: All changes, those of other pages included.

tools.name: keyed_summary
tools.description: Compare two files of records by key, independent of row order: CSV, NDJSON or pg_dump COPY blocks. Returns how many keys were added, removed and changed, and the first 10 of each with their lines and, for COPY, their table. `key` is `csv:NAME`, `csv:N`, `json:PATH` or `copy:NAME`. Reads both files on every call and keeps nothing between calls. Needs a `mem` of at least about 260K to 400K, depending on the pair, because 128 KiB of it is held for the answer. Duplicate keys fail the call.

a.description: Path of file A, the old one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

b.description: Path of file B, the new one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

key.description:
Where the key is, as `--key`: `csv:NAME` (header name), `csv:N`
(column N, from 1), `json:PATH` (NDJSON field, dotted for nested)
or `copy:NAME` (column of a `pg_dump` COPY block).

mem.description:
Memory budget for the diff of this pair, like `--mem`: `64M`, `1G`.
Used only when the call builds the diff; a live diff keeps its own.
Default 64M, at most 256M.

KeyRef.description: A key and where it is.

a_line.description: The record's first line in A, 1-based; null for an added key.

b_line.description: The record's first line in B; null for a removed key.

key.description: The key as the file has it, quotes included, cut at 256 bytes.

table.description:
The `COPY` table as its header names it, unescaped; null outside
`pg_dump` files.

changed.description: Keys in both with different record bytes.

first_added.description: The first added keys, at most 10.

first_changed.description: The first changed keys, at most 10.

first_removed.description: The first removed keys, at most 10.

mem_budget_bytes.description: Memory budget of the run, in bytes.

passes.description: Passes over the files. More than 1 means the budget was tight.

tools.name: next_difference
tools.description: The first differing range of A that starts after the 1-based line `after_line` (0 for the first one). Pass a returned a.start to step to the next. The range is from the segment map before refinement and can take in equal lines next to a change; `hunks_at` gives the exact lines.

a.description: Path of file A, the old one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

after_line.description:
The answer starts after this 1-based line of A; 0 for the first
difference. Pass a returned `a.start` to get the one after it.

b.description: Path of file B, the new one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

mem.description:
Memory budget for the diff of this pair, like `--mem`: `64M`, `1G`.
Used only when the call builds the diff; a live diff keeps its own.
Default 64M, at most 256M.

status.description: `differs`, or `approx` when the local diff was cut short.

range.description:
The difference, when found. Like the ranges of `summary`, it can take
in equal lines next to a change; `hunks_at` gives the exact lines.

tools.name: summary
tools.description: Summarize the diff of two text files: line counts, segment counts by status, the first differing ranges and memory use. The ranges come from the segment map before refinement: they can take in equal lines next to a change. `hunks_at` gives the exact lines. Builds the diff and keeps it for the other tools.

a.description: Path of file A, the old one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

b.description: Path of file B, the new one. Must be a regular file, not a symlink.

mem.description:
Memory budget for the diff of this pair, like `--mem`: `64M`, `1G`.
Used only when the call builds the diff; a live diff keeps its own.
Default 64M, at most 256M.

status.description: `differs`, or `approx` when the local diff was cut short.

approx.description:
Refined segments whose local diff was cut short, out of
`refined_segments`.

differs.description:
Differing segments not known to be approximate: not refined yet, or
refined exactly.

first_differences.description:
The first differing ranges in file order, at most 20. They come from
the segment map before refinement and can take in equal lines next to
a change; `hunks_at` gives the exact lines.

identical.description: The files hold the same bytes.

mem_budget_bytes.description: Memory budget of this diff, in bytes.

mem_reserved_bytes.description: Bytes of that budget the diff holds now.

refined_segments.description: Differing segments refined so far. It grows as hunks are asked for.

steps.note: How different are the two dumps?
The widest change in the list. Show only the start of it.
And the difference after that one?
Ask for a bigger memory budget than the server allows.

content.text: mem 1073741824 is over the limit of 268435456 per diff
